_meta.scope: US sellers, full returns where the item comes back. Includes eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Whatnot, and Vinted. Partial refunds are v2.
_meta._note: Keys beginning with _ are NOTES for the owner and are NEVER shown or used in math. Edit the numbers here when a platform changes fees; re-check quarterly.

ebay.label: eBay
ebay._note: eBay US 2026: 13.6% final value fee on MOST categories (books 15.3%, trading cards/coins 13.25%) on the part up to $7,500, then 2.35%. Per-order fee is $0.30 for orders of $10 or less and $0.40 above $10.

poshmark.label: Poshmark
poshmark._note: Poshmark 2026: 20% commission on sales of $15+, or a flat $2.95 under $15; buyer pays $6.49 flat shipping; no recurring fees.

mercari.label: Mercari
mercari._note: Mercari US 2026: 10% selling fee (back since Jan 6, 2025). There is NO separate seller payment-processing fee.

depop.label: Depop
depop._note: Depop US 2026: NO selling fee for US/UK/AUS sellers. Payment processing is 3.3% + $0.45 via Depop Payments (Stripe).

whatnot.label: Whatnot
whatnot._note: Whatnot US 2026: 8% commission (4% Coins & Money, 4% Pallets). Payment processing is 2.9% + $0.30 on gross order value (item + shipping + tax). The $0.30 fixed fee is charged per CHECKOUT. High-value promo: 0% commission on portion above $1,500 in eligible categories.

vinted.label: Vinted
vinted._note: Vinted US 2026: $0 seller fees. Buyer pays $0.70 + 5% protection fee plus shipping.
